description: Na₇Sr₂Fe₇F₃₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.52 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.78 Å. Sr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.94 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. There are two shorter (1.92 Å) and four longer (1.97 Å) Fe-F bond lengths. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-43°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.98 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-43°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.04 Å. There are nine inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Fe atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Fe tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Fe atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one Fe atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Fe atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one Fe atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two Fe atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one Fe atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Fe atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Fe atoms.
